items.note: The previous attempt had already fixed this, and I checked it. reservations/hours.ts works out the weekday from the Karachi calendar date (pktDayOfWeek). Once a brand has set any hours, reservableWindows treats a day with no rows as closed instead of falling back to 11:00-23:00 (the default applies only when no hours are set at all). POST /reservations/public now refuses a sitting outside that day's windows with 409 CLOSED (sittingInHours, which handles windows past midnight). Tests in auditOnlineReservations: 2026-10-12 is a Monday; only the configured weekday has slots and the next day has none; a booking outside the hours is refused and one inside is accepted.

The fix belongs in backend/src/modules/groupOrders/routes.ts, which is outside my file list (exact change in needsOtherFiles). To keep that change small, I added and exported assertItemsServedAt(conceptId, menuItemIds, at) in storefront/serviceHours.ts. It applies the same Karachi-time section rule as checkout and returns 400 ITEM_UNAVAILABLE. A new test in auditOnlineCheckout covers it, including the two-brand case. assertOpenForOrders was already exported from the same file.

Checkout shows only the methods in quote.paymentMethods (today cash only). The JazzCash, EasyPaisa and Keenu phone field, the redirect note and the 'Continue to Keenu' label are gone. If the chosen method is not listed, the page resets to cash. On 422 PAYMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE from the quote or checkout, it resets to cash, uses details.available and shows the message.

On 409 BRAND_CLOSED from the quote or checkout, the page shows error.message in the danger colour, disables Place Order and labels the button 'Closed right now'. OrderingScreen shows a status banner from menu.ordering.message, built with --servd tokens and an SVG clock (no emoji).

Check now sends the gift card code through the quote. quote.giftCardError.message shows under the field, and giftCardCode is sent only when the card is valid. If the placed order comes back with a giftCardError, a 'placed' screen shows the message and a link to track the order.
Checkout loads loyalty points from /storefront/account?conceptSlug=<slug>. The two-company account test passes.

The reserve page sends the customer token on availability and booking, and pre-fills name, phone and email from the account. When no WhatsApp message was sent, it shows the confirm/cancel link (/reserve/confirm/<token>) with a hint to sign in or verify a phone. On 409 SLOT_FULL or CLOSED it shows the message and reloads availability. Slot dayparts now use the Karachi hour, and the emoji tick is replaced with an SVG.

The reservation-completion bonus goes through loyalty/service creditPointsTx, at the account of the brand's company, inside the claim transaction, then bookEarn (Dr 6060 / Cr 2060). That is the same path the review bonus uses. It is idempotent because of the conditional status claim. Covered by a test in auditOnlineReservations (A's books only, credited once).
